| 2024‑04‑15 10:13 | 系統 | “抱歉，我目前無法直接發送訊息。請您自行使用工作區內的訊息功能向同事 Catherine 發送更新。” |

> - 您已成功聯繫客服並收到回覆。

如果您需要任何進一步協助（例如確認客服回覆、追蹤問題進度或手動發送訊息），請隨時告訴我！

They likely refer to the conversation where they contacted customer support and then asked to send a message to colleague. We need to summarize all responses that were sent after the communication about flight issues. That includes the customer support response and the message sent to colleague. But we didn't actually send the message to colleague; we said we can't. So maybe we need to summarize the responses that were sent: the customer support message and the attempt to send message to colleague. Let's produce a summary.
